answer: A payout is split so that 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The terrace schedule is applied in onyx and shale shows each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 756 identities would post 668 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
